emerging_technology: LLM-based tool-using AI agent that retrieves approved policies and case records, analyzes complaints, proposes routing and drafts replies under employee approval
intended_application: Employee-assisted intake, investigation support, routing/escalation suggestions and response drafting for web-submitted credit-card billing disputes
industry_sector: Business process outsourcing for retail-bank complaints
business_need: Protect revenue and reposition services as bank clients adopt agent-assisted complaint handling
users_stakeholders: Bank clients, end customers, outsourcing staff, commercial leadership and quality/audit teams
adoption_posture: Fast follower willing to redesign services and pricing
capabilities_constraints: Assume strong complaint-handling expertise but most revenue is linked to billed handling hours. Access to client systems is contractual; fixed-price/outcome services are an option, not an existing proven business.
risk_consequence_context: Misunderstood disputes, unsupported explanations, missed escalation, privacy exposure, customer frustration and excessive reviewer burden. Employees retain final authority; no autonomous refunds, denials or external messages.
management_question: How much does the same AI threaten a labor-priced complaints provider and what commercial response is justified?
time_horizon: Decide now; mid-term 12-36 month revenue exposure is a scenario assumption conditional on client adoption and contract renewals.
